title: Ocheeze nke jere ije n'otu ntabi anya
intro: Onye nwere ikike dị ukwuu chịrị alaeze bara ọgaranya nke e ji akụnụba nke ukwuu gọzie. Mgbe ihe ịma aka a na-atụghị anya ya bilitere, onye ọchịchị a chere ule ihu ọ bụghị site na mma agha kama site n'amamihe na okwukwe. Ihe ga-eme ga-eduga site n'ike ụwa ruo n'ọkwa dị elu nke mgbanwe obi.
clues: Achịala m alaeze nke jupụtara n'akụnụba na ọganihu karịrị echiche efu
Abụ m eze dị ike nke natara akwụkwọ ozi siri ike nke na-achọ ka e nye m ikike n'aka ya.
Ndị isi m dụrụ m ọdụ gbasara ma m ga-alụ ọgụ ma ọ bụ mee udo na eze dị anya a.
Ebu m onyinye dị ebube gawa izute eze dị anya a n'onwe m
E buliri ocheeze eze m gaa n'ala dị anya n'otu ntabi anya, tupu m alọghachi.
Mgbe m banyere n'obí eze nwere ala dị nro dị ka iko, emesịrị m kwupụta nrubeisi m nye Allah

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
